draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 6.39, the 29th-best grade among 259 2023 draftees and 5th of 36 at CB. He lasted until pick 105, well after his grade rank (29th): he slid relative to the published grade. Published comparison: Jimmy Smith. Testing standouts: 40-yard dash (88th percentile). Testing concerns: three-cone (3rd percentile), vertical jump (12th percentile). College production: 7 passes defended in 2022, 15th of 36 CBs in his class with stats.

current.summary: Year 4 pro, currently with the Philadelphia Eagles. 51 career games and 8 starts over 3 completed seasons, plus 4 so far in 2026. Producing near his peak: 2 AV in 2025 against a career-best 2 in 2023. Strengths in 2025: completion % allowed 56.0% (77th percentile). Versus the typical Year-3 cornerback who played: 27.6% season snap share against a median of 40.4%, below the norm.
